responsibility: Implements out-of-line behavior for HIR generic-parameter nodes. It provides constructors, cloning support, and basic formatting/visitor bodies for the abstract `GenericParam` base and concrete lifetime and const generic parameter classes, wiring their `Analysis::NodeMapping`, bounds, default values, attributes, and source locations into the lowered HIR representation used by item, function, trait, and impl declarations.
same_name_distinction: Implements the behavior of the generic-parameter classes declared in `rust-hir-generic-param.h`, including constructors, copy/cloning, stringification, and visitor bodies for `GenericParam`, `LifetimeParam`, and `ConstGenericParam`. Unlike the header, it is the implementation file and does not introduce the reusable generic-parameter class interfaces.
